comment: V2 readiness target profile. Facts grounded in Microsoft Learn: Bedrock 1.26.50 ships @minecraft/server 2.10.0 and @minecraft/server-ui 2.2.0 as stable, releases custom dimension JSON from experimental, and tightens entity JSON validation at format_version 1.26.50+. Dimension height: minecraft:dimension_height min_y defaults -64 (absolute range -512..512), height_range defaults 384 (range 16..1024); at format_version 1.26.50 the legacy minecraft:dimension_bounds (min/max) must be replaced by min_y=min and height_range=max-min. Without experiments, dimensions stay within the default Overworld heights -64..320. sound_definitions.json gains allow_concurrent_streaming, defaulting to true at format_version 1.26.50+. Keep this file data-only; edit rules in audit.py.

format_version.geometry_note: models/**/*.geo.json use the separate geometry format scheme (1.8.0-1.21.x); they are inventoried but never flagged.
unversioned_ok: ui files, texts/languages.json, loot_tables, biomes_client.json carry no format_version and are inventoried only

entity_schema_at_1_26_50.projectile_isolated_physics_true: content error at format_version 1.26.30 and later
entity_schema_at_1_26_50.projectile_multiple_targets_default: flips from true to false at format_version 1.26.50

sound_at_1_26_50.note: defaults to true for sound objects at format_version 1.26.50 and later; looping/streamed playback behavior changes when bumping sound_definitions.json

api_flags.name: world.beforeEvents.worldInitialize
api_flags.reason: worldInitialize before-event was removed in @minecraft/server 2.0.0; check the stable 2.10.0 changelog for the supported replacement

api_flags.name: world.afterEvents.worldInitialize
api_flags.reason: WorldInitializeAfterEvent was removed in @minecraft/server 2.0.0; check the stable 2.10.0 changelog for the supported replacement

api_flags.name: world.beforeEvents.chatSend
api_flags.reason: Absent from the stable @minecraft/server 2.10.0 typings; available in beta

api_flags.name: dimension
api_flags.reason: Script-registered custom dimension (DimensionRegistry.registerCustomDimension, stable since 2.8.0). At 1.26.50 custom dimension JSON is also stable: prefer BP/dimensions/<id>.json with minecraft:dimension_height and remove the startup registration.
